facts.fact: The Liberia Telecommunications Authority put its draft Satellite Communications Guidelines (LTA-GLL-002-2026) out for written comment from 23 February to 9 March 2026, asking licensed service providers, satellite operators and other stakeholders for their views, with a public consultation forum scheduled for 5 March.
The LTA states it ran the consultation on the draft Satellite Communications Guidelines in accordance with its published Guidelines for Consultation Process of 2009.

note: The consultation report is scheduled for 12 March 2026 but the document does not say it was published, so no answered fact.
